title: Garlicky Spinach Namul
summary: A quick spinach side dish: blanched for seconds, squeezed dry, then tossed with garlic, sesame oil and toasted sesame seeds. Lives in the fridge for a few days of easy banchan.

creator.bio: Sample creator. Korean home cooking the way my mom taught me: stews, banchan and noodles for busy nights.

ingredients.name: spinach
ingredients.notes: mature bunch spinach holds up better than baby spinach

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: plus a pinch for the water

steps.instruction: Bring a large pot of water to a boil with a pinch of salt. Fill a bowl with cold water next to the stove.
success_cues: Water is at a full rolling boil
Cold water bowl is ready before the spinach goes in
warnings: Boiling water: pour away from you and use oven mitts on the pot handles.

steps.instruction: Push the spinach under the boiling water and cook for 30 to 45 seconds, then lift it straight into the cold water.
success_cues: Leaves turn deep bright green and just wilt
Stems still bend with a little spring
warnings: Boiling water: pour away from you and use oven mitts on the pot handles.
steps.creator_note: Don't walk away here. A minute too long and it goes slimy.

steps.instruction: Gather the spinach into a ball and squeeze out as much water as you can, then cut the ball in half once or twice.
success_cues: Spinach holds together as a firm, compact ball
Only a few drops come out on a final squeeze
warnings: Sharp knife: curl your fingertips under and keep the board steady on a damp towel.

steps.instruction: Loosen the spinach in a bowl. Add the garlic, soy sauce, sesame oil, remaining salt and scallion if using, and mix with your fingers so every strand is coated.
success_cues: Strands are separated and glossy with oil
Tastes lightly salty with a clear garlic bite

steps.instruction: Crush the sesame seeds between your fingers as you sprinkle them over. Serve at room temperature or chilled.
success_cues: Seeds are scattered evenly and smell nutty

creator_notes: Keeps covered in the fridge for 3 days.
dietary_warnings: Contains soy and wheat (soy sauce) and sesame.
